name: Dimensional depth stage — title card
description: Verification fixture for the ADR-0028 dimensional depth stage. The newspaper title card sits on a near 3D plane over a backdrop plane at depth; a slow camera push makes the two reproject at different rates (real parallax), and a rack focus pulls from the backdrop onto the title. Drives the depth-stage render path via state.stage (the flat multiplane path, ADR-0027, is untouched). backgroundFill is the backdrop colour — the surface composite stays card-on-transparent.
